gpu_only.method: The profiler's CUDA-event stages include host work: `prepare` (observation resize/normalize on the CPU, e.g. 480x480 MetaWorld frames for pi0.5: ~30 of its 38.7 ms "stage1") and host dispatch gaps. The R15/R16 pi0.5/GR00T LIBERO prices (D5) are CUDA-graph times only, so pricing now counts GPU time only on every line: per measured iteration, the stage's compiled graph(s) plus the non-graph kernels in its window, CPU time on neither side (as the CPU text-encoder rule already did for DP).
